title: Personal Checking: bank-error refund of an overdraft protection transfer fee
content:
## Situation and business effect

This entry applies to a Personal Checking account that carries an overdraft protection transfer fee, the fee charged when funds move from a linked savings account to cover a debit. It governs whether such a fee is returned to the owner as a bank-error correction and, when it is, at what amount. When a refund is owed, the agent posts it; the owner then sees the refund in the account activity and the posted ledger balance rises by the refunded amount at once. When no refund is owed, nothing is posted under this entry.

## How the refund is posted

The refund is posted with the internal tool **refund_transfer_fee_error_033d9cbf**. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then called (call_agent_discoverable_tool) by the agent.

**What one call does.** One call writes one refund entry on the account, dated today, that refunds the named overdraft protection transfer fee entry, records the refund as a bank-error correction for the overdraft transfer fee, and raises the account's posted ledger balance by the refunded amount at once. The tool records exactly the amount given against the named fee; it does not check the fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Class | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| checking_account_id | Id | Reference number of the checking account the transfer fee was charged to, as returned by the checking account lookup | Reference string |
| customer_id | Id | Customer reference number of the owner of that checking account, as returned by the customer profile lookup | Reference string |
| source_item_id | Id | Reference number of the overdraft protection transfer fee entry being refunded, as returned by the checking activity lookup | Reference string |
| amount | Fixed format | The refund in U.S. dollars, always positive | Plain number with 2 decimal places, rounded half-up, for example 12.34 |
| statement_cycle | Fixed format | The statement cycle in which today's posting falls | YYYY-MM, the month in which that statement cycle closes |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new refund entry reference number, the fee entry it refunds, the amount refunded in USD with 2 decimal places, and the account's new posted ledger balance in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the refund is posted.

## Calling contract Q&A

**Q: Will the tool reject a fee that does not qualify?**
A: No. The tool does not check the fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund; the decision whether a refund is owed, and its amount, is made before the call.

**Q: Which entry goes in source_item_id, the transfer or the transfer fee?**
A: The overdraft protection transfer fee entry being refunded.

**Hypothetical call and receipt (illustrative references only):** checking_account_id "CHK-EXAMPLE", customer_id "CUST-EXAMPLE", source_item_id "FEE-EXAMPLE", amount 7.50, statement_cycle "2026-07". The receipt names a new refund entry, fee FEE-EXAMPLE, 7.50 USD refunded, and the new ledger balance.
